The laptops are expected to feature Nvidia's N1 and N1X system-on-a-chip and could launch as early as the first quarter, according to a Digitimes report. This move signifies Nvidia's potential entry into the Windows on Arm market.

title: Dynatrace achieves DESC certification to accelerate secure cloud adoption for Dubai’s public sector
summary: Dynatrace has received certification from the Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) for its SaaS platform operating on UAE Microsoft Azure. This certification validates that Dynatrace meets the UAE Government's cybersecurity standards, enabling Dubai's public sector organizations to confidently adopt secure cloud services and accelerate their digital transformation initiatives. The platform aims to simplify complexity, drive smarter operations, and deliver seamless digital services while adhering to regional regulatory requirements.

title: Bristol Myers Squibb Announces Collaboration with Microsoft to Advance AI-Driven Early Detection of Lung Cancer
summary: Bristol Myers Squibb and Microsoft have announced a collaboration to accelerate the early detection of lung cancer using AI-driven radiology solutions. The initiative will deploy U.S. FDA-cleared radiology AI algorithms via Microsoft's Precision Imaging Network to help identify lung nodules, triage patients, and ensure follow-up, particularly in medically underserved communities. This partnership aims to improve operational efficiency, patient outcomes, and address health disparities by leveraging AI for earlier diagnosis and access to optimal care pathways.

title: Bristol Myers Squibb Teams Up with Microsoft for AI-Powered Lung Cancer Detection
summary: Bristol Myers Squibb and Microsoft have announced a collaboration to enhance early lung cancer detection using AI-powered analysis of X-ray and CT images through Microsoft's Precision Imaging Network. The initiative aims to deploy FDA-cleared AI algorithms, particularly focusing on underserved communities and rural clinics, to combat the high rate of patients lost to follow-up after incidental findings. This partnership seeks to improve health equity and patient outcomes by rapidly identifying individuals at risk for non-small cell lung cancer.

title: Where Will Constellation Energy Be in 3 Years?
summary: Constellation Energy is set to significantly expand and diversify its operations in the next three years, particularly with the acquisition of Calpine, which will make it a leader in gas power production. The company is also capitalizing on the resurgence of nuclear energy by securing new power purchase agreements with tech giants like Microsoft and Meta Platforms for its nuclear plants. These strategic moves are expected to result in a much larger and more profitable Constellation Energy by 2029, driven by increasing power demand from AI data centers and electrification.

title: Has Alphabet Stock Hit Its Top at $4 Trillion?
summary: Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL) recently crossed the $4 trillion market cap level but subsequently experienced a pullback, mirroring similar behavior seen with other megacap stocks like Apple (AAPL) and Nvidia (NVDA) after reaching significant market cap milestones. While short-term volatility is common after such peaks, historical data suggests that stocks closing above trillion-dollar thresholds generally show positive long-term returns, with many outperforming the S&P 500 Index over a year. This pattern indicates that despite immediate "hangovers," long-term buy-and-hold strategies for those bullish on Big Tech may still be viable.
